Class.summary: Controller responsible for retrieving the chronological activity timeline and audit trail for a ticket.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The service used to obtain the current authenticated user's ID and role.

GetActivities.summary: Retrieves the chronological audit trail and activity log for a specific ticket.
GetActivities.remarks: Access is authorized using role-based ticket ownership checks: Admins can access any ticket; Agents can access assigned tickets; Customers can access their own tickets.
GetActivities.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the ticket.
GetActivities.returns: A chronological list of activity log entries recorded for the ticket.
GetActivities.response: If the user is not authenticated.
If the ticket does not exist or the caller lacks access permission.
